observations.behavior: The buffer module no longer records a gauge on every message insertion; the gauge is now recorded only when a batch is flushed. The flush buffer size configuration is updated to account for multiple lanes.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes a per-message metric recording, reducing the cost of the consumer loop. This could help throughput and reduce latency, but the tier depends on the writer implementation, which is not shown.

observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration option for the number of parallel writer lanes, while retaining the original single-writer behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a configuration option for multi-lane writers. This could increase throughput and reduce latency, but the tier depends on the writer implementation, which is not shown.

observations.behavior: Changes the consumer to support multiple lanes, each with its own buffer and writer, and the flush buffer size is clamped to half the per-lane capacity.
